name: strix-run-artifact-integrity-and-degraded-f088
instr:
Strix cannot prove whether a stored run is complete, degraded, corrupt, legacy, or unavailable. Build a deterministic local integrity record without making usable reports depend on publication or verification success. Preserve report representations, artifact ordering, viewer finished-state calculation, terminal bounds, lifecycle behavior, and locked-history privacy.

Normalize run-relative paths, rejecting escapes. Record each declared artifact's requiredness, role, size, and digest, deriving generation identity only from that state. Offline, read-only verification requires no credentials or mutation. It classifies every artifact and distinguishes missing required or optional files, malformed records, and unrecorded legacy runs with actionable paths.

Atomically persist one generation covering run metadata, finding indexes and documents, coverage, SARIF, executive output, and integrity metadata. Optional coverage or SARIF failure degrades publication without failing it. Recover derivable indexes only from verified, declared evidence. Preserve primary, unrelated, and undeclared files, reject undeclared evidence, and expose unrecoverable corruption.

Viewer summaries, detailed payloads, and terminal projections retain usable content and expose matching, bounded, normalized status, generation, and affected paths. Never expose full integrity records, digests, or unbounded artifact collections. Locked history keeps its teaser disclosure; verified access adds bounded summaries. Ve
